answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and books a ferrous shipment to a delta port under a copper tag. Cargo is weighed against the tag at the delta dock; short or swapped cargo burns the bond, tally published. First delivery 45, then 45+6(k-1) each: each fake needs its cargo, carrier and forged tag, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented manifests fail: tallies are key-signed to hulls. Honest shippers pay 45 once, keeping the bond.
